content_units: A warm, reflective 12-song set that stays gentle and uplifting without getting too heavy. It leans indie-folk and acoustic pop, keeps lyrics mostly in English, and avoids explicit picks.
Reason: Spacious, tender, and quietly awe-filled; it sets a thoughtful travel mood without feeling sad.
Reason: Soft harmonies and light acoustic texture make this an easy early-journey settle-in song.
Reason: Warm guitar work and nostalgic imagery give it that window-seat, passing-landscape feeling.
Reason: A little brighter and more rolling, this lifts the energy just enough in the first third.
Reason: Delicate and intimate, with emotional depth that stays graceful rather than gloomy.
Reason: Reflective and conversational, ideal for the midpoint when the ride turns inward a bit.
Reason: Rich harmonies and open-road imagery make it feel made for long-distance travel.
Reason: Airy, warm, and immersive; it keeps the mood soft while adding a dreamy drift.
Reason: One of the most reassuring songs in this lane—earnest, melodic, and emotionally light enough to recharge the set.
10.   First Day of My Life — Bright Eyes
Reason: Simple acoustic writing and hopeful sincerity bring intimacy without heaviness.
Reason: A slightly stronger rhythmic pulse helps the playlist feel like it is gently moving toward arrival.
12.   Rivers and Roads — The Head and the Heart
Reason: Warm, human, and quietly cathartic; it lands with emotional closure that suits the end of a long ride.
- Best first-track choice because it eases you into motion gently and instantly creates a reflective travel atmosphere.
Recommended closer: Rivers and Roads — The Head and the Heart
- Best final-track choice because it feels like arrival: emotional, warm, and memorable without ending on a dark note.
-   First 4 songs:   soft entry, golden-hour scenery, easy momentum
-   Middle 4 songs:   more introspective but still comforting
-   Last 4 songs:   warmer, fuller, and quietly resolving
